novelty.note: Proceed only as China-based population-calibrated, time-varying measured byline-exposure design; raw surname-success, citation-only, country-level surname-distribution, and generic long-run exposure claims are occupied prior art.

chinese_surname_population_baseline.note: ChineseNames 2025.8 official source tarball reproduced the exact 1,806 surname identities and population counts (total 1,181,719,774). CCNC supplies surname-specific pronunciation/order. Corrected mapped denominator covers 99.9671% of population.

crossref_structured_surname_route.note: Tier 1B route accepted with DOI resolution, author-list reconciliation, structured family value, and non-conflicting identity evidence. Heuristic last-token parsing remains excluded.

randomized_measurement_gate.note: Random field/year samples show strong DOI/Crossref and positional support, with coverage heterogeneity reported.

field_year_alphabetization_variance.note: Measured excess alphabetization varies meaningfully across fields/years and persists in 3+ author analyses.

source_context_reliability.note: Targeted source contexts were feasible, but split-half Spearman reliability was poor (0.156; 3+ authors 0.083). Prospectively frozen rule therefore rejects raw source-level exposure as primary. Primary moderator is field × prior-3-year window; source × field × window is secondary/exploratory after shrinkage.

longitudinal_panel_feasibility.note: Repeated author histories are retrievable; 2024 seed is feasibility-only and cannot define the confirmatory cohort.

person_identity_resolution.note: Raw work-embedded OpenAlex author IDs showed 6.24% mismatch against ORCID-resolved authors, but 61/61 mismatches were repaired by resolving the embedded ID to its current canonical OpenAlex author. Longitudinal joins must canonicalize IDs first; residual non-ORCID split/merge risk remains a mandatory sensitivity-analysis issue.

cohort_definition.note: Entry cohort frozen to 2014-2020 with 3-year clean lookback and 5-year follow-up; distal confirmatory endpoint is observed five-year publication persistence.

exposure_estimator.note: Primary context is primary_topic field × prior-3-year window; source-level raw exposure rejected as primary; within-author exposure variation passed; exact LOAO rule frozen in process/LOAO_EXPOSURE_RULE.md.

preregistration.note: TBF fields remain; pre-outcome CI prevents advancement to preregistered/analysis while unresolved.

all_field_scope.note: All 26 current OpenAlex primary-topic fields passed the prospective output-volume and structured-order feasibility gate. Six anchor fields are validation anchors only.

within_author_exposure_variation.note: 70/100 sampled authors had >=3 primary-field exposure-defined years; among those, 81.4% had within-author exposure range >=0.05 versus a prospectively frozen 50% threshold. Longitudinal extension remains eligible.

surname_romanization.note: Pinned CCNC surname-specific Romanization replaces generic pypinyin/legacy ChineseNames initials as pronunciation/order authority.

global_time_window.note: All-26-field historical audit froze focal work window to 2011-2025.

loao_implementation.note: Five synthetic/hand-computable checks passed: tie-aware chance, work contributions, exact LOAO subtraction with per-work author deduplication, D-threshold behavior, and non-contributor invariance.

synthetic_model_smoke.note: Synthetic-only fixest work-FE model with frozen three-way clustering passed. True interaction 0.55 recovered as 0.6121 (SE 0.0631) over 2,962 rows, 600 works, 869 authors and 174 field-year clusters.

longitudinal_sampling.note: H3 is nested in the balanced primary work frame: only authors sampled in their validated entry year 2014-2020 can enter; no later-survivor seeding or second-stage author subsampling. Structural adequacy thresholds are frozen before persistence is opened.

hard_rule: Do not run or inspect focal surname-rank × exposure career-effect estimates until confirmatory_outcomes_unlocked is explicitly set true after preregistration freeze.
